result.summary: The page is mostly intact, with no clear layout breakage. There are two minor inconsistencies: the favorite (heart) button styling differs between cards, and one card shows the same delivery information twice. Clipped carousel items, chips and the bottom card are intentional and not reported.

issues.description: The heart button on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has no visible circular backdrop. On the card below it, the heart sits on a semi-transparent dark circle. On the ramen card the white heart floats directly on the image, making it look unfinished or missing its container.
issues.suggestion: Give all favorite buttons the same circular backdrop so they look consistent and stay legible on any image.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows '€0 delivery' twice: once as a badge on the image and again in the metadata row below. This takes up space without adding information.
issues.suggestion: Keep the image badge for promotions and drop the repeated text from the metadata row, or the reverse.

issues.description: The metadata row under Tokumaru Ramen Bar ('25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen') looks bolder and darker than the secondary text in the 'Fastest near you' cards (e.g. '€0.90 delivery'). This makes the typography of secondary text inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Use the same font weight and color token for secondary metadata across all restaurant cards.
